# Vendored: nameof

Snapshot of **nameof**, a header-only C++17 library for compile-time names.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/Neargye/nameof>
- Version: **v0.10.6** (2025-07-04)
- License: MIT (see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE))

Vendored as the single header `nameof.hpp` (upstream `include/nameof.hpp`).

## Local patches

None — pristine upstream. (The previous snapshot was an untagged commit between
v0.10.1 and v0.10.2; this is now pinned to a release tag.)

## Updating

Copy `include/nameof.hpp` and `LICENSE` from the new tag over this directory.
